integration: Keep PR41657 fused BF16 Q-RoPE path and retain PR41603 q_rope_store only for FP8 outputs.

runtime_optimizations.name: Bound DSV4.1 prefill sparse-indexer metadata pairing scans
runtime_optimizations.integration_adjustments: None; clean cherry-pick. Prefill only, when a request has more than 1024 query rows. Original request IDs remain stored for tail rebuilding; only DeepGEMM schedule grouping receives bounded pair IDs. Decode, verification and score tiling unchanged.

validation.isolated_gpu: Nine exact-logit comparisons passed, including long/odd-length and empty-request segments, with distinct KV pages per request.
validation.microbenchmark_caveat: Synthetic 2048 candidate blocks, 100000 context, GB300. Not an end-to-end speedup.

full_model_fix_only.status: Passed matched request replay and four-rank PyTorch trace. Not lab-stack validation or a model-quality evaluation.
full_model_fix_only.hardware: Same replacement 4xGB300 node before and after
full_model_fix_only.controls: Identical launch args/env, TP4/EP1, DSPARK block 5 and simulated acceptance 5.4, chunk 16384, HuggingFace tokenizer. Only sparse_table.py patched. Three measured repeats; warmup excluded.
full_model_fix_only.caveat: Kernel sums are not additive critical-path time. Decode code unchanged; do not attribute generation-time variation to this prefill-only patch. No TRT or fastokens patch in this A/B.

runtime_optimizations.name: fastokens serving with independent HuggingFace Engram tokenizer
runtime_optimizations.integration_adjustments: None; cherry-picked before standalone rebase onto Oasis-Git/main. All three patch files are identical after rebase. No changes to Engram hashing or GPU kernels.

validation.regression_tests: 4 passed, including processor argument forwarding and HF backend isolation after fastokens activation.
validation.prompt_parity: 185 texts: 370 exact encode checks, 370 exact decode checks, 2 batch checks passed.

full_model_fix_only.status: Passed; not a lab-stack performance measurement.
full_model_fix_only.controls: Same recovered chat, token hash, cache hits and output counts. SGLang C1 TP4/EP1 recipe, DSPARK block 5 with simulated acceptance 5.4, chunk 4096, prefill interval 0; ignore_eos=true in replay. Only this patch and fastokens==0.1.2/--tokenizer-backend fastokens added. Original AgentX runtime nonce omitted (11 fewer input tokens).

validation.gpu_q_rope: 3 tests passed on GB300: BF16 exact output/padding, BF16 graph replay, FP8 rounding/padding (10 shape/index-type subcases). New helper and tests loaded in isolation against the existing tested SGLang runtime.
validation.full_model_combined_branch: 8K/1-output-token BS1 cold-cache serving and all-rank torch profile completed on 4xGB300. Not a model-quality or AgentX c64 validation.

experiments.name: mega-mhc-prefill

runtime.note: Runtime overlay; this experiment does not change the dependency pins.

experiments.validation: Three chained-boundary numerical tests passed at 4K, 8K, 16K; same greedy output token in all 30 server requests; scoped pre-commit checks passed. Prefill trace confirms 77 Mega mHC calls per request.
experiments.limitations: Test-only eager prefill path; no full quality, c64 AgentX, or complete CPU critical-path validation. Engram shared hash/history preparation is outside the stage annotations.
